svg.text: Not to scale. All values in mm. One number = one value. Fill in docs/measurements.md.

g.text: A Display lid, front (glass facing you)
Hinge edge at the bottom. 0,0 = bottom-left corner.
Lid width, outer edge to outer edge
Lid height, outer edge to outer edge (hinge stubs not included)
Corner radius, seen from the front
Bezel left: lid edge to the first lit pixel
Bezel right: lid edge to the first lit pixel
Bezel top: lid edge to the first lit pixel
Bezel bottom: lid edge to the first lit pixel
4–7: screen on with a white image, or to the edge of the dark panel area.
B Lid, bottom edge (zoom of A)
Same 0,0 as A. The hinge stubs stick out on the glass side.
Hole x from 0,0 (every old hinge screw hole)
Hole diameter, and thread if threaded (M2 / M2.5)
Cable exit: start x from 0,0 (where the cables really leave)
Hinge stub: height, from the bottom edge up
Stubs come off with their screw, no force? Remove them, skip 13–15 and 18.
Glass up. Hinge edge on the right.
Thickness 3 mm in from the edge, all 4 sides (the clamp grips here)
Hinge stub: how far it sticks out past the glass
0,0 = bottom-left corner. Odd outline? Add a photo from straight above with a ruler.
Hole x from 0,0 (every hole H1, H2, …)
Blower intake centre: x from 0,0 (both blowers)
Fin stack exhaust: start x from 0,0 (both)
Fin stacks sit on one long edge: draw that edge at the top, like here.
Blowers + heatpipes: height above the board
Tallest other part on the heatsink side (RAM, SSD)
Tallest part on the screen side
F DC-in jack (on its own cable)
The original jack gets mounted in the case wall.
Cable length, jack to board connector
How was the jack held in the laptop (bracket, screw)? Add a photo.
eDP cable length, connector to connector (laid flat, not stretched)
Wi-Fi antenna cable lengths, from the M.2 card
